definitionZh: 内置大小的 CSS 属性定义了元素块沿内置轴的大小. 如果书写模式是水平的,则对应宽度;如果书写模式是垂直的,则对应高度. 一个相关的属性是块大小,它定义了元素的另一个维度.
sourceDefinition: The inline-size CSS property defines the size of an element's block along the inline axis. If the writing-mode is horizontal, it corresponds to the width; if the writing mode is vertical, it corresponds to the height. A related property is block-size, which defines the other dimension of the element.
